breakEven.menuEstimate: There are no sales with a known cost yet, so the variable cost rate is the average of menu items with a recipe and a price. It switches to actual sales once the store is trading.
breakEven.noCostRate: There are no sales with a known cost and no menu recipes yet, so the variable cost rate and break-even point can't be calculated.
breakEven.noPaymentFeeRate: No payment fee data yet, so the break-even point leaves payment fees out for now.
breakEven.note: Revenue includes tax; the 5% business tax is backed out of it. Cost of goods uses recipes at current ingredient prices, including add-ons and modifiers. Payment fees are the amounts ECPay reports; cash costs nothing. Income tax follows Article 5 of the Income Tax Act by annualising the month's profit, so it is an estimate until the yearly filing. Daily figures are spread over the open days from the opening hours and special hours.
